gloss: to pull in, to draw into

definitions.gloss: to pull in, to draw into
definitions.explanation: To bring or draw something or someone into a space or situation.
To get someone involved in a situation, often unwillingly.

examples.japanese: {客|きゃく}を{店|みせ}に{引|ひ}き{込|こ}む。
examples.english: To draw customers into the store.

examples.japanese: {物語|ものがたり}の{世界|せかい}に{引|ひ}き{込|こ}まれた。
examples.english: I was drawn into the world of the story.

examples.japanese: {トラブル|とらぶる}に{引|ひ}き{込|こ}まれた。

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
Formed from {引|ひ}く (to pull) + {込|こ}む (to go into). The suffix 込む adds the meaning of going or being pulled into something.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb. Related term: {引|ひ}きこもる (to withdraw, shut oneself in - intransitive).
